nativeValidation.setup: Use a short disposable checkout of the indicated revision and a non-elevated PowerShell session at its repository root. Run commands 1 and 2, copy the probe from files.copyFrom to files.copyTo, then run the remaining commands in order. The probe uses Go overlays for controlled script-string mutations. It writes scratch files inside the checkout.
